trans-unit.source: Title under which this configuration can be found.
trans-unit.target: Te taitara e kitea ai tēnei whirihoranga.

trans-unit.source: Setting `testing` to `true` will cause Klaro to not show the consent notice or modal by default, except if a special hashtag is appended to the URL (#klaro-testing). This makes it possible to test Klaro on your live website without affecting normal visitors.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi i `testing` ki `true`, kāore a Klaro e whakaatu taunoa i te pānui whakaaetanga, i te modal rānei, engari mēnā ka tāpirihia he hashtag motuhake ki te URL (#klaro-testing). Mā tēnei ka taea te whakamātau i a Klaro i tō paetukutuku ora me te kore e pā ki ngā manuhiri noa.

trans-unit.source: By default, Klaro loads the configuration from a global variable `klaroConfig`. You can change this here. Specifying this field will cause the attribute data-klaro-config="yourConfigVariableName" to be set.
trans-unit.target: Hei taunoa, ka uta a Klaro i te whirihoranga mai i tētahi taurangi ao `klaroConfig`. Ka taea e koe te huri i konei. Mā te whakakī i tēnei āpure ka tautuhia te huanga data-klaro-config="yourConfigVariableName".

trans-unit.source: You can customize the ID of the `div` element that Klaro will create when starting up. By default, Klaro will use "klaro".
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te whakarite i te ID o te huānga `div` ka hangaia e Klaro i te tīmatanga. Hei taunoa, ka whakamahi a Klaro i "klaro".

trans-unit.source: Setting this to `true` will keep Klaro from automatically loading itself when the page is being loaded.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi i tēnei ki `true`, kāore a Klaro e uta aunoa i a ia anō i te utanga o te whārangi.

trans-unit.source: You can specify an additional class (or classes) that will be added to the Klaro `div`.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te tohu i tētahi karaehe tāpiri, i ētahi karaehe rānei, ka tāpirihia ki te `div` Klaro.

trans-unit.source: You can customize how Klaro persists consent information in the browser. Specify either `cookie` (the default) or `localStorage`.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te whakarite me pēhea a Klaro e pupuri ai i ngā mōhiohio whakaaetanga ki te pūtirotiro. Tohua `cookie` (te taunoa), `localStorage` rānei.

trans-unit.source: You can customize the name of the cookie or localStorage entry that Klaro will use for storing the consent information. By default, Klaro will use "klaro".
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te whakarite i te ingoa o te pihikete, o te tāurunga localStorage rānei, ka whakamahia e Klaro hei rokiroki i ngā mōhiohio whakaaetanga. Hei taunoa, ka whakamahi a Klaro i "klaro".

trans-unit.source: If set to `true`, Klaro will render the texts given in the `consentModal.description` and `consentNotice.description` translations as HTML. This enables you to e.g. add custom links or interactive content. If you want to be able to output HTML tags via fluid-enriched labels (see "Content" → "Translations"), this option must be enabled.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi ki `true`, ka render a Klaro i ngā kuputuhi kei ngā whakamāoritanga `consentModal.description` me `consentNotice.description` hei HTML. Mā tēnei ka taea, hei tauira, te tāpiri hononga ritenga, ihirangi pāhekoheko rānei. Ki te hiahia koe ki te whakaputa HTML tags mā ngā fluid-enriched labels (tirohia "Ihirangi" → "Whakamāoritanga"), me whakahohe tēnei kōwhiringa.

trans-unit.source: Setting "embedded" to `true` will render the Klaro modal and notice without the modal background, allowing you to e.g. embed them into a specific element of your website, such as your privacy notice.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi i "embedded" ki `true`, ka render te modal me te pānui Klaro me te kore papamuri modal, kia taea ai, hei tauira, te tāmau ki tētahi huānga motuhake o tō paetukutuku, pērā i tō pānui tūmataiti.

trans-unit.source: You can group services by their purpose in the modal. This is advisable if you have a large number of services. Users can then enable or disable entire groups of services instead of having to enable or disable every service.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te whakarōpū ratonga mā tō rātou kaupapa i roto i te modal. He pai tēnei mēnā he maha ō ratonga. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi te whakahohe, te whakaweto rānei i ngā rōpū ratonga katoa, kaua ko ia ratonga takitahi.

trans-unit.source: You can change the cookie domain for the consent manager itself. Use this if you want to get consent once for multiple matching domains. By default, Klaro will use the current domain. Only relevant if `storageMethod` is set to `cookie`.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te huri i te rohe pihikete mō te consent manager ake. Whakamahia tēnei mēnā e hiahia ana koe kia kotahi te whakaaetanga mō ētahi rohe ōrite maha. Hei taunoa, ka whakamahi a Klaro i te rohe o nāianei. E hāngai ana anake mēnā kua tautuhia `storageMethod` ki `cookie`.

trans-unit.source: Provide a path if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/"
trans-unit.target: Tukuna he ara mēnā he ratonga āu e tautuhi ana i ngā pihikete mō tētahi ara ehara i te "/"
Ka pau te pihikete i muri i ngā rā

trans-unit.source: You can also set a custom expiration time for the Klaro cookie. By default, it will expire after 60 days. Only relevant if `storageMethod` is set to `cookie`.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea hoki e koe te tautuhi i tētahi wā paunga ritenga mō te pihikete Klaro. Hei taunoa, ka pau i muri i ngā rā 60. E hāngai ana anake mēnā kua tautuhia `storageMethod` ki `cookie`.

trans-unit.source: Defines the default state for services in the consent modal (`true` = enabled by default). If this setting is set to "false", you can override it in any service.
trans-unit.target: Ka tautuhi i te tūnga taunoa mō ngā ratonga i te modal whakaaetanga (`true` = kua whakahohea taunoatia). Ki te tautuhi tēnei tautuhinga ki "false", ka taea te whakakapi i roto i tētahi ratonga.

trans-unit.source: If `mustConsent` is set to `true`, Klaro will directly display the consent manager modal and not allow the user to close it before having actively consented to or declined the use of third-party services.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `mustConsent` ki `true`, ka whakaatu tika a Klaro i te modal consent manager, ā, kāore e tukua te kaiwhakamahi kia kati i mua i tana whakaae kaha, whakakāhore rānei i te whakamahinga o ngā ratonga rōpū tuatoru.

trans-unit.source: Setting `acceptAll` to `true` will show an "accept all" button in the notice and modal, which will enable all third-party services if the user clicks on it. If set to "false", there will be an "accept" button that will only enable the services that are enabled in the consent modal.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `acceptAll` ki `true`, ka whakaatu he pātene "accept all" i te pānui me te modal, ā, ka whakahohe i ngā ratonga rōpū tuatoru katoa mēnā ka pāwhiria e te kaiwhakamahi. Ki te tautuhi ki "false", ka noho he pātene "accept" ka whakahohe anake i ngā ratonga kua whakahohea i te modal whakaaetanga.

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideDeclineAll` to `true` will hide the "decline" button in the consent modal and force the user to open the modal in order to change his/her consent or disable all third-party services. We strongly advise you to not use this feature, as it opposes the "privacy by default" and "privacy by design" principles of the GDPR (but might be acceptable in other legislations such as under the CCPA)
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `hideDeclineAll` ki `true`, ka hunaia te pātene "decline" i te modal whakaaetanga, ā, ka akiaki i te kaiwhakamahi kia whakatuwhera i te modal kia taea ai te huri i tana whakaaetanga, te whakaweto rānei i ngā ratonga rōpū tuatoru katoa. E tino taunaki ana mātou kia kaua e whakamahi i tēnei āhuatanga, nō te mea e whakahē ana i ngā mātāpono "privacy by default" me "privacy by design" o te GDPR (engari tērā pea ka whakaaetia i raro i ētahi atu ture pērā i te CCPA).

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideLearnMore` to `true` will hide the "learn more / customize" link in the consent notice. We strongly advise against using this under most circumstances, as it keeps the user from customizing his/her consent choices.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `hideLearnMore` ki `true`, ka hunaia te hononga "learn more / customize" i te pānui whakaaetanga. E tino taunaki ana mātou kia kaua e whakamahia i te nuinga o ngā āhuatanga, nō te mea ka aukati i te kaiwhakamahi ki te whakarite i āna kōwhiringa whakaaetanga.

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideToggleAll` to `true` will hide the "toggle all" link in the consent notice.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `hideToggleAll` ki `true`, ka hunaia te hononga "toggle all" i te pānui whakaaetanga.
Whakaatu te pānui pihikete hei modal
Whakaatu taitara ki te pānui whakaaetanga

trans-unit.source: When this option is enabled, Klaro displays the title in the notice modal.
trans-unit.target: Ina whakahohea tēnei kōwhiringa, ka whakaatu a Klaro i te taitara i te modal pānui.

trans-unit.source: Show an explanatory text in contextual consent placeholders when no consent storage exists yet (first visit / empty store). This informs users that a permanent decision ("Always") requires allowing Klaro to store consent first. This only has an effect in contextual consent widgets/overlays (e.g. for embedded media) and only if the consent store (cookie/localStorage) is empty.
trans-unit.target: Whakaatu he kuputuhi whakamārama i ngā placeholder whakaaetanga horopaki ina kāore anō he rokiroki whakaaetanga (haerenga tuatahi / rokiroki kau). Ka whakamōhio tēnei ki ngā kaiwhakamahi me tuku a Klaro kia rokiroki whakaaetanga i mua i te whakatau pūmau ("Always"). Ka pā tēnei ki ngā widget/overlay whakaaetanga horopaki anake (hei tauira mō te pāpāho kua tāmaua), ā, anake mēnā he kau te consent store (cookie/localStorage).

trans-unit.source: Automatically focus the Klaro consent notice/modal container when it opens to improve keyboard navigation and accessibility.
trans-unit.target: Arotahi aunoatia te ipu pānui/modal whakaaetanga Klaro ina whakatuwheratia, hei whakapai ake i te whakatere papapātuhi me te accessibility.

trans-unit.source: You can also remove the "Realized with Klaro!" text in the consent modal. Please don't do this! We provide Klaro as a free open source tool. Placing a link to our website helps us spread the word about it, which ultimately enables us to make Klaro! better for everyone. So please be fair and keep the link enabled. Thanks :)
trans-unit.target: Ka taea hoki e koe te tango i te kuputuhi "I hangaia mā Klaro!" i te modal whakaaetanga. Tēnā kaua e pēnei! Ka whakarato mātou i a Klaro hei taputapu open source koreutu. Mā te tuku hononga ki tō mātou paetukutuku ka āwhina ki te hora i te kōrero mōna, ā, i te mutunga ka taea e mātou te whakapai ake i a Klaro! mō te katoa. Nō reira tēnā kia tika, kia noho whakahohea te hononga. Ngā mihi :)

trans-unit.source: Here you specify the third-party services that Klaro will manage for you.
trans-unit.target: I konei ka tohu koe i ngā ratonga rōpū tuatoru ka whakahaerehia e Klaro māu.

trans-unit.source: The order in which purposes appear in the notice and modal can be changed via the `purposeOrder` parameter, which can be given a list with purpose names and will display those purposes in the order in which they appear in the list.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea te huri i te raupapa e puta ai ngā kaupapa i te pānui me te modal mā te parameter `purposeOrder`, ā, ka taea te hoatu he rārangi ingoa kaupapa, ka whakaatu i aua kaupapa i te raupapa e puta ana i taua rārangi.

trans-unit.source: You can define an optional callback function that will be called each time the consent state for any given service changes. The consent value will be passed as the first parameter to the function (`true` = consented). The `service` config will be passed as the second parameter. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(consent, service) { }`
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tētahi callback function kōwhiri ka karangahia ia wā ka huri te tūnga whakaaetanga mō tētahi ratonga. Ka tukuna te uara whakaaetanga hei parameter tuatahi ki te function (`true` = kua whakaaetia). Ka tukuna te config `service` hei parameter tuarua. Ka takaihia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki `callback: function(consent, service) { }`

trans-unit.source: Optional path to an additional XLIFF file that overwrites the default labels or adds new labels (e.g. for custom purposes or services). If fluid templates have been stored for the labels created in this file (see the "Fluid Template Root Path" field), these will overwrite the classic labels from the Locallang file. Nevertheless, it is possible and common to reference the locallang file from the respective fluid template and obtain the actual label there (the label key is passed to the fluid template).
trans-unit.target: Ara kōwhiri ki tētahi atu kōnae XLIFF e whakakapi ana i ngā labels taunoa, e tāpiri ana rānei i ngā labels hou (hei tauira mō ngā kaupapa, ratonga ritenga rānei). Mēnā kua rokirokia ngā fluid templates mō ngā labels i hangaia ki tēnei kōnae (tirohia te āpure "Fluid Template Root Path"), ka whakakapi ēnei i ngā labels matarohia mai i te kōnae Locallang. Heoi anō, ka taea, he mea noa hoki, te tohutoro i te kōnae locallang mai i te fluid template e hāngai ana, ā, te tiki i te label tūturu ki reira (ka tukuna te label key ki te fluid template).

trans-unit.source: As an alternative to the usual TypoScript configuration via constants under `plugin.tx_klaroconsentmanager.view`, a Fluid root path can be defined here, which has a higher priority than the paths configured in TypoScript. The three default directories `/Layouts/`, `/Partials/` and `/Templates/` are expected under this path. Fluid templates created here are used to enrich Locallang labels with additional functionality or to replace them completely. In this way, dynamic content or more complex HTML structures can be provided in a simple way. Fluid templates that are to override labels are expected in the subdirectory `/Templates/Labels/`.
trans-unit.target: Hei kē atu i te whirihoranga TypoScript noa mā ngā constants i raro i `plugin.tx_klaroconsentmanager.view`, ka taea te tautuhi i tētahi Fluid root path ki konei, ā, he teitei ake tōna matua i ngā ara kua whirihorahia ki TypoScript. E tūmanakohia ana ngā kōpaki taunoa e toru `/Layouts/`, `/Partials/` me `/Templates/` i raro i tēnei ara. Ka whakamahia ngā Fluid templates i hangaia ki konei hei whakarangatira i ngā Locallang labels ki ētahi mahi tāpiri, hei whakakapi katoa rānei. Mā konei ka taea te tuku ihirangi hihiri, hanganga HTML uaua ake rānei mā te huarahi māmā. E tūmanakohia ana ngā Fluid templates ka whakakapi i ngā labels i te kōpakiroto `/Templates/Labels/`.

trans-unit.source: Determines the alignment of the Consent box if `mustConsent` and `noticeAsModal` are disabled.
trans-unit.target: Ka whakatau i te whakatakotoranga o te pouaka whakaaetanga mēnā kua monokia `mustConsent` me `noticeAsModal`.

trans-unit.source: Default color scheme used for the display. The colors can also be overridden later via CSS variables.
trans-unit.target: Kaupapa tae taunoa e whakamahia ana mō te whakaaturanga. Ka taea hoki te whakakapi i ngā tae ā muri ake mā ngā CSS variables.

trans-unit.source: If this option is set to `true`, a button is created in the frontend (via JavaScript) directly in front of the closing body tag, which triggers the opening of the Klaro consent management.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi tēnei kōwhiringa ki `true`, ka hangaia he pātene ki te frontend (mā JavaScript) i mua tonu i te closing body tag, ā, ka whakatuwhera i te whakahaere whakaaetanga Klaro.

trans-unit.source: If this option is set to `true`, a button is generated in the frontend (via JavaScript) directly in front of the closing body tag, which triggers the resetting of all settings and the opening of the Klaro consent management.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi tēnei kōwhiringa ki `true`, ka hangaia he pātene ki te frontend (mā JavaScript) i mua tonu i te closing body tag, ā, ka tautuhi anō i ngā tautuhinga katoa me te whakatuwhera i te whakahaere whakaaetanga Klaro.

trans-unit.source: Each service must have a unique name. Klaro will look for HTML elements with a matching `data-name` attribute to identify elements that belong to this service.
trans-unit.target: Me whai ingoa ahurei ia ratonga. Ka rapu a Klaro i ngā huānga HTML me tētahi huanga `data-name` ōrite hei tautuhi i ngā huānga nō tēnei ratonga.

trans-unit.source: The title defined here is not mandatory and is intended for backend display only.
trans-unit.target: Kāore te taitara kua tautuhia ki konei e herea ana, ā, mō te whakaaturanga backend anake.

trans-unit.source: If `default` is set to `true`, the service will be enabled by default. This overrides the global `default` setting (if this is set to "false").
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `default` ki `true`, ka whakahohe taunoatia te ratonga. Ka whakakapi tēnei i te tautuhinga `default` ao (mēnā kua tautuhia tēnei ki "false").

trans-unit.source: The purpose(s) of this service that will be listed on the consent notice. Do not forget to add translations for all purposes you list here.
trans-unit.target: Te/ngā kaupapa o tēnei ratonga ka whakarārangitia ki te pānui whakaaetanga. Kaua e wareware ki te tāpiri whakamāoritanga mō ngā kaupapa katoa ka whakarārangitia e koe ki konei.

trans-unit.source: You can either only provide a cookie name or regular expression (regex) or a list consisting of a name or regex, a path and a cookie domain. Providing a path and domain is necessary if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/", or a domain that is not the current domain. If you do not set these values properly, the cookie can't be deleted by Klaro, as there is no way to access the path or domain of a cookie in JS. Notice that it is not possible to delete cookies that were set on a third-party domain, or cookies that have the HTTPOnly attribute: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/cookie#new-cookie_domain
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te tuku ingoa pihikete, regular expression (regex) rānei anake, tētahi rārangi rānei kei roto he ingoa, he regex rānei, he ara me tētahi rohe pihikete. Me tuku ara me te rohe mēnā he ratonga āu e tautuhi ana i ngā pihikete mō tētahi ara ehara i te "/", mō tētahi rohe ehara rānei i te rohe o nāianei. Ki te kore koe e tautuhi tika i ēnei uara, kāore e taea e Klaro te muku i te pihikete, nā te mea kāore he ara i JS hei uru ki te ara, rohe rānei o tētahi pihikete. Kia mōhio hoki kāore e taea te muku ngā pihikete i tautuhia ki tētahi rohe rōpū tuatoru, ngā pihikete rānei kei a rātou te huanga HTTPOnly: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/cookie#new-cookie_domain

trans-unit.source: If `required` is set to `true`, Klaro will not allow this service to be disabled by the user. Use this for services that are always required for your website to function (e.g. shopping cart cookies).
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `required` ki `true`, kāore a Klaro e tuku kia whakawetohia tēnei ratonga e te kaiwhakamahi. Whakamahia tēnei mō ngā ratonga e hiahiatia tonutia ana kia mahi tō paetukutuku (hei tauira, ngā pihikete kete hoko).

trans-unit.source: If `optOut` is set to `true`, Klaro will load this service even before the user has given explicit consent. We strongly advise against this.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `optOut` ki `true`, ka uta a Klaro i tēnei ratonga ahakoa kāore anō te kaiwhakamahi kia tuku whakaaetanga mārama. E tino taunaki ana mātou kia kaua e pēnei.

trans-unit.source: If `onlyOnce` is set to `true`, the service will only be executed once regardless how often the user toggles it on and off. This is relevant e.g. for tracking scripts that would generate new page view events every time Klaro disables and re-enables them due to a consent change by the user.
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhi `onlyOnce` ki `true`, ka mahia kotahi anake te ratonga ahakoa te maha o ngā wā ka whakakā, ka whakaweto hoki te kaiwhakamahi. He mea hāngai tēnei, hei tauira, mō ngā tracking scripts ka whakaputa kaupapa page view hou ia wā ka whakaweto, ka whakahohe anō a Klaro i a rātou nā te huringa whakaaetanga a te kaiwhakamahi.

trans-unit.source: Content can be excluded from general consent by setting contextualConsentOnly to `true`. In this case, the consent must be contextual.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea te aukati i te ihirangi mai i te whakaaetanga whānui mā te tautuhi contextualConsentOnly ki `true`. I taua wā, me noho horopaki te whakaaetanga.

trans-unit.source: You can define an optional callback function that will be called each time the consent state for the given service changes. The consent value will be passed as the first parameter to the function (`true` = consented). The `service` config will be passed as the second parameter. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(consent, service) { }`. `consent` is a bool that reflects the current state. `service` holds all information about the currently selected service. When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tētahi callback function kōwhiri ka karangahia ia wā ka huri te tūnga whakaaetanga mō te ratonga kua tohua. Ka tukuna te uara whakaaetanga hei parameter tuatahi ki te function (`true` = kua whakaaetia). Ka tukuna te config `service` hei parameter tuarua. Ka takaihia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki `callback: function(consent, service) { }`. He bool a `consent` e whakaatu ana i te tūnga o nāianei. Kei a `service` ngā mōhiohio katoa mō te ratonga kua tīpakohia. Ina tuhi koe ki konei, me mōhio koe ki tāu e mahi ana. Kei a koe te kawenga kia kaua e puta he hapa JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Here you can define JavaScript code that will be called each time the service was accepted. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. The object `handlerOpts` contains the objects `config` (the current Klaro! configuration), `service` (the current service) and possibly `vars` (any values defined by object notation in the vars field in the backend). When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: I konei ka taea e koe te tautuhi JavaScript code ka karangahia ia wā ka whakaaetia te ratonga. Ka takaihia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. Kei roto i te object `handlerOpts` ngā object `config` (te whirihoranga Klaro! o nāianei), `service` (te ratonga o nāianei) me te āhei pea ko `vars` (ngā uara kua tautuhia mā te object notation i te āpure vars i te backend). Ina tuhi koe ki konei, me mōhio koe ki tāu e mahi ana. Kei a koe te kawenga kia kaua e puta he hapa JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Here you can define JavaScript code that will be called once per page-load. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. The object `handlerOpts` contains the objects `config` (the current Klaro! configuration), `service` (the current service) and possibly `vars` (any values defined by object notation in the vars field in the backend). When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: I konei ka taea e koe te tautuhi JavaScript code ka karangahia kotahi i ia page-load. Ka takaihia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. Kei roto i te object `handlerOpts` ngā object `config` (te whirihoranga Klaro! o nāianei), `service` (te ratonga o nāianei) me te āhei pea ko `vars` (ngā uara kua tautuhia mā te object notation i te āpure vars i te backend). Ina tuhi koe ki konei, me mōhio koe ki tāu e mahi ana. Kei a koe te kawenga kia kaua e puta he hapa JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Here you can define JavaScript code that will be called each time the service was declined. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. The object `handlerOpts` contains the objects `config` (the current Klaro! configuration), `service` (the current service) and possibly `vars` (any values defined by object notation in the vars field in the backend). When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: I konei ka taea e koe te tautuhi JavaScript code ka karangahia ia wā ka whakakāhoretia te ratonga. Ka takaihia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. Kei roto i te object `handlerOpts` ngā object `config` (te whirihoranga Klaro! o nāianei), `service` (te ratonga o nāianei) me te āhei pea ko `vars` (ngā uara kua tautuhia mā te object notation i te āpure vars i te backend). Ina tuhi koe ki konei, me mōhio koe ki tāu e mahi ana. Kei a koe te kawenga kia kaua e puta he hapa JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Variables that can be used in callback functions. The content of this field is enclosed in curly brackets. The JavaScript object notation is expected in them. When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: Ngā taurangi ka taea te whakamahi i roto i ngā callback functions. Ka karapotia te ihirangi o tēnei āpure ki ngā taiapa piko. E tūmanakohia ana te JavaScript object notation i roto. Ina tuhi koe ki konei, me mōhio koe ki tāu e mahi ana. Kei a koe te kawenga kia kaua e puta he hapa JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Identification and presentation of the cookie
trans-unit.target: Tautuhi me te whakaaturanga o te pihikete

trans-unit.source: This information is technically evaluated by Klaro! to manipulate the cookie.
trans-unit.target: Ka aromātaihia tēnei mōhiohio e Klaro! i te taha hangarau hei raweke i te pihikete.

trans-unit.source: This is a unique identifier for this cookie. It must be written in lower case and must not contain any spaces, only the characters a-z, 0-9 and "-" or "_". The identifier can be used in Fluid, for example.
trans-unit.target: He tautuhi ahurei tēnei mō tēnei pihikete. Me tuhi ki ngā pū iti, kaua e whai mokowā, ā, ko ngā pūāhua a-z, 0-9 me "-" rānei "_" anake. Ka taea te whakamahi i te tautuhi ki Fluid, hei tauira.

trans-unit.source: If set, this title will be used in the frontend/backend for displaying the cookie. This title has no technical relevance (contrary to the `pattern` field).
trans-unit.target: Ki te tautuhia, ka whakamahia tēnei taitara ki te frontend/backend hei whakaatu i te pihikete. Kāore he hāngaitanga hangarau o tēnei taitara (he rerekē ki te āpure `pattern`).

trans-unit.source: Provide a path if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/"
trans-unit.target: Tukuna he ara mēnā he ratonga āu e tautuhi ana i ngā pihikete mō tētahi ara ehara i te "/"

trans-unit.source: Provide a domain if you have services that set cookies for a domain that is not the current domain.
trans-unit.target: Tukuna he rohe mēnā he ratonga āu e tautuhi ana i ngā pihikete mō tētahi rohe ehara i te rohe o nāianei.

trans-unit.source: Number of years/months/days/hours/minutes/seconds that will elapse before this cookie expires.
trans-unit.target: Te maha o ngā tau/marama/rā/hāora/meneti/hekona ka hipa i mua i te paunga o tēnei pihikete.

trans-unit.source: Unit used for the "Expires after" specification. The special value `end-of-session` does not need a numeric value and hides the "Expires after" field accordingly.
trans-unit.target: Te wae e whakamahia ana mō te whakatakotoranga "Expires after". Kāore te uara motuhake `end-of-session` e hiahia uara tau, ā, ka huna i te āpure "Expires after" kia hāngai.

trans-unit.source: When a service is selected in this field, the content item is displayed via contextual consent only if the user has agreed to use the selected service in the Klaro! Consent Manager. Please make sure that the static TypoScript template of the Klaro! Consent Manager has been added to use this feature.
trans-unit.target: Ina tīpakohia he ratonga i tēnei āpure, ka whakaaturia te tūemi ihirangi mā te whakaaetanga horopaki anake mēnā kua whakaae te kaiwhakamahi ki te whakamahi i te ratonga kua tīpakohia i te Klaro! Consent Manager. Tēnā whakaritea kua tāpirihia te static TypoScript template o te Klaro! Consent Manager hei whakamahi i tēnei āhuatanga.

trans-unit.source: Do not show the initial notice. The manager can still be opened manually or via contextual consent.
trans-unit.target: Kaua e whakaatu i te pānui tuatahi. Ka taea tonu te whakatuwhera ā-ringa i te manager, mā te whakaaetanga horopaki rānei.

trans-unit.source: Override the “powered by” link in the consent modal. Leave empty to use Klaro default.
trans-unit.target: Whakakapihia te hononga “powered by” i te modal whakaaetanga. Waiho kia kau hei whakamahi i te taunoa Klaro.

trans-unit.source: Prefix for CSS classes/container to namespace Klaro styles.
trans-unit.target: Kuhimua mō ngā CSS classes/container hei namespace i ngā kāhua Klaro.
